description: Header file defining the PID AutoTune class and related constants, structures, and macros for PID auto-tuning algorithms in embedded systems.

classes.name: PID_AutoTune
classes.description: Class implementing PID auto-tuning algorithms with methods for configuration, execution, and retrieval of tuning parameters.

classes.name: Tuning
classes.description: Structure representing tuning rule divisors and PI controller check.

methods.name: PID_AutoTune
methods.description: Constructor for PID_AutoTune class, initializes auto-tuning process.

methods.name: Runtime
methods.description: Performs auto-tuning step, returns true when tuning is complete.

methods.name: SetOutputStep
methods.description: Sets the output step size for auto-tuning.

methods.name: GetOutputStep
methods.description: Retrieves the current output step size.

methods.name: SetControlType
methods.description: Sets the control algorithm type for auto-tuning.

methods.name: GetControlType
methods.description: Gets the current control algorithm type.

methods.name: SetLookbackSec
methods.description: Sets the lookback period in seconds for peak detection.

methods.name: GetLookbackSec
methods.description: Gets the lookback period in seconds.

methods.name: SetNoiseBand
methods.description: Sets the noise band threshold to ignore signal chatter.

methods.name: GetNoiseBand
methods.description: Gets the current noise band threshold.

methods.name: GetKp
methods.description: Returns the proportional gain after tuning.

methods.name: GetKi
methods.description: Returns the integral gain after tuning.

methods.name: GetKd
methods.description: Returns the derivative gain after tuning.

methods.name: setOutput
methods.description: Sets the output value during auto-tuning.

methods.name: setState
methods.description: Sets the current state of the auto-tuner.

methods.name: setPeakType
methods.description: Sets the type of peak detection used.
